summary: Action is dutch multinational variety store chain, founded in 1993. About 74,500 employees (Wikidata). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 3 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 1 about funding; 4 about legal trouble, strikes or bankruptcy.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants
Google News RSS (headline and link only), last 90 days, fetched 2026-10-06

insights.one_liner: Dutch discount store chain with shops across Europe; its Zwaagdijk head office hires IT and finance staff, often in English.

culture.text: A discount retailer selling household items, toys and food at low prices across Europe.
Head office is in Zwaagdijk-Oost (North Holland), where current IT and finance roles are based.
A very large employer: about 74,500 staff in 2023.

open.text: IND recognised visa sponsor (Action Service & Distributie).
All 3 current jobs here (mid, senior and manager in IT and finance) don't require Dutch, and 2 of 3 mention visas or relocation.

growth.text: Staff grew from 68,000 in 2022 to 74,500 in 2023.

worth_knowing.text: Ultimate parent of its Dutch entity is Peer Holding I B.V.; Wikidata lists investment firm 3i as an owner.
Action warned customers about mould on sweets it sold.
